review.name: Ash Crown Phoenix
findings: Original twelve source head/body slices and all 216 equipped-technique frames inspected. Complete beak and crest were bound to neck rather than head; misplaced stock pivots and wing influence pinched the throat. Both actual feet carried opposite-foot weights and the attack sank soles 0.2528 below the floor. Candidate V11 fits two visible legs and neck/head pivots, separates central throat from wings, and feathers measured shoulder seams. All original 21 bone frames/inverses, sculpt, UVs and textures retained; 170 legacy curves preserved with eleven intentional root/torso support changes. All twelve candidate raw slices and 216 native technique frames actually inspected and pass. Original frozen facial patches pass 2017 poses and 468 blends; 1731 full-geometry poses have zero warnings. Both soles sampled at 481 times per action drift at most 0.000077 with floor excursion above -0.000068 and no head/neck contribution. Final rebuilt battle and repeat review pending.

Separate final visual pass actually inspected 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, all 24 advancing idle frames, all 216 equipped-technique frames in twelve native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and rebuilt battle assets each pass 2017 frozen face poses plus 468 blends and 1731 full-geometry poses with zero warnings. Independent visible soles pass 481 samples per action on source 78/77 and battle 41/45 original-box vertices; support drift below 0.000077 and floor excursion above -0.000068. Thirteen focused anatomy/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Live release and whole-roster review remain pending.
